mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp line 1047, `for i in 0..13: if (i + 7 != 15) AccessModel(MODEL_WING + i + 7, L"Data\\Item\\", L"Gem", i + 1)`, so group 12 number n is Gem{n-6}: number 8 is Gem02, and _enum.h names MODEL_WING + 8 MODEL_ORB_OF_HEALING. OpenMU's 0.75 Orbs.cs puts the Orb of Healing at 12, 8.
why_this_one: The elf's first orb, and the first thing that teaches a skill to anybody but the Dark Wizard. It is Elf Lala's slot 16, which stood dark until this row existed - Realm.Shelf drops a stock line it has no row for - and it is what the elf in Noria buys to learn Heal. See docs/orbs.md.
mesh_note: No geometry of its own. Gem01.bmd through Gem05.bmd are byte-identical in MuMain's Data/Item - one md5, 7f77c0f0431776282922bd924bb193f4, across all five - so the orbs are one model told apart by the row, the same way the twelve Books are Book01. Gem05 was built first because the Orb of Summoning was the first orb a Lorencia monster could leave, so it carries the sphere and its pearl sheet and this names it.

stats.note: OpenMU's row, copied rather than restated, with the call it came from. An orb has no damage roll and no hand, so it is a Prize and nothing else. See shared/Rows.cs.
stats.call_note: CreateOrb(number, skillNumber, height, name, dropLevel, levelRequirement, energyRequirement, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, money, characterClasses). It sets Group = 12, Width = 1, DropsFromMonsters = true and Durability = 1 itself.
stats.durability_note: One. One reading, as a scroll is.
stats.classes_from: CharacterClasses.FairyElf. Read by Prize.ReadBy in Realm.Read, so a knight or a wizard cannot learn it at any energy.

skill.note: What the orb teaches. The energy is MuMain's and not OpenMU's, and the two disagree - see energy_from.
skill.name: Heal
skill.energy_from: OpenMU's call says 100, and GetRequirement returns a non-wearable's MinimumValue unscaled, so OpenMU asks an elf for a hundred energy. MuMain does not: ZzzInfomation.cpp:786 scales every group-12 energy as `20 + RequireEnergy * (ItemLevel + Level * 3) * 4 / 100`, which at drop level 8 and +0 is 20 + 100 * 8 * 4 / 100 = 52. Fifty-two is also SkillsInitializer.cs:65's own energyRequirement for Heal, and the same formula gives the other two orbs 72 and 92, which are Greater Defense's and Greater Damage's to the point. So 100 is the table's raw column and 52 is the requirement, and the client is what a player was shown.
